lastCommand:
git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(physics): implement DCA collision detection and limit CIWS to one attempt per tick

Task 6: Address Missile Tunneling
- Replace end-of-tick distance check with DCA (Distance of Closest Approach) 
  detection using point_to_segment_distance
- Prevents missiles from "phasing through" targets when traveling at 3x ship speed
- Missile path segment from start to end of tick is checked against ARRIVAL_DISTANCE

Task 7: Balance CIWS (Fleet Wall Prevention)
- Change CIWS logic from sequential all-ships-attempt to one random ship attempt
- Collect all ships in CIWS_RANGE, randomly select one, let only that ship roll
- Prevents "Fleet Wall" effect where multiple ships multiply intercept probability
- Missile now faces single probability roll per tick instead of cascading rolls

Task 8: Verification
- Added test_dca_missile_tunneling_detection: verifies missile path detection works
- Added test_dca_missile_misses: verifies missiles don't false-positive on near misses
- All 14 physics tests pass with no warnings

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
